Case Study 01 — Continued
Pack & pricing selector
Comparison table
What I Worked On
  • Homepage design & hero section
  • Trust bar & social proof placement
  • Pack / subscription pricing module
  • "Original vs low quality" comparison table
  • Reviews section layout
Design Thinking

An olive-and-cream palette signals natural wellness rather than a clinical, pharma look.

The pack selector isolates the pricing decision from general browsing, so the visitor makes one choice at a time instead of several at once.

Case Study 02

Siraj Collection

Industry
Fitness / Posture Support
Platform
Shopify
Scope
Store Design · Trust & Comparison Sections
The Objective

Build a direct-response style Shopify store for posture-support and body-shaping products, designed to explain an unfamiliar product quickly and move paid traffic straight toward a purchase.

siraj collection — homepage
Siraj vs Others
What I Worked On
  • Hero with product callout diagram
  • Top picks product grid
  • Trust stats section
  • "Siraj vs Others" comparison table
Design Thinking

Circular callouts on the hero explain product materials at a glance — useful when the visitor has never seen the product before.

The same comparison-table pattern used on Biyode reappears here — a consistent trust-building method across different builds.
